description: Comprehensive enhancement plan covering security, UI/UX, features, performance, and testing

tasks.title: Create shared UI component library (Button, Input, Select, Card, Badge, Textarea, Dialog, Skeleton)
tasks.description: Build reusable UI primitives under components/ui/ using CSS variables from globals.css. Each component accepts standard HTML props. This is the foundation for all subsequent UI work.
acceptanceCriteria: components/ui/ directory with: button.tsx, input.tsx, select.tsx, card.tsx, badge.tsx, textarea.tsx, dialog.tsx, skeleton.tsx
Each component uses CSS variables (--accent, --border, --surface-raised, etc.) for theming
Components accept standard HTML props via React.ComponentProps
Exported from a barrel index file
tasks.notes: Do not refactor existing pages yet — just create the primitives. Subsequent tasks will adopt them.

tasks.title: Implement toast notification system
tasks.description: Create a ToastProvider and useToast hook. Toasts appear top-right, auto-dismiss after 5s, support success/error/info variants, and animate in/out.
acceptanceCriteria: ToastProvider wraps children in app layout.tsx (or dashboard layout)
useToast() returns { toast } with success/error/info methods
Toasts appear in top-right, stack vertically, auto-dismiss after 5 seconds
tasks.notes: Consider using the Sonner library for simplicity, or build a minimal custom implementation.

tasks.title: Add React error boundaries
tasks.description: Create an ErrorBoundary component and wrap the dashboard layout and individual complex pages (Studio, Chat) with it.
acceptanceCriteria: components/error-boundary.tsx with 'Something went wrong' UI and 'Try Again' button
Root error boundary wraps dashboard layout children
tasks.notes: Next.js App Router has error.tsx convention — use that for page-level boundaries.

tasks.title: Add Zod validation to all API routes
tasks.description: Add Zod schemas for request body validation on every POST/PATCH/DELETE API route. Return 400 with structured error on invalid input.
acceptanceCriteria: Every POST/PATCH/DELETE API route validates request body with Zod
Invalid requests return 400 with { error: string, issues?: ZodIssue[] }
tasks.notes: Zod is already a dependency. Pattern exists in chat-tools.ts.

tasks.title: Add database indexes (GIN on campaignProfiles, status, dates)
tasks.description: Create a new Prisma migration adding GIN index on KbFact.campaignProfiles and standard indexes on RenderJob.status, RenderJob.campaignProfile, ScheduledPost.scheduleDate.
acceptanceCriteria: GIN index on KbFact.campaignProfiles for array containment queries
tasks.notes: Use @@index with raw SQL for GIN index: CREATE INDEX ... USING GIN ("campaignProfiles")

tasks.title: Make seed script idempotent (upsert instead of deleteMany)
tasks.description: Refactor prisma/seed.ts to use upsert for curated facts and template, and skip ingestion if source pages already exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Curated facts use upsert matched by sourceSite + key (or a stable ID)
Default video template uses upsert matched by id
Ingest skips source pages that already exist
Running seed twice produces the same result

tasks.title: Standardize API response shapes
tasks.description: Create lib/api-helpers.ts with apiSuccess and apiError helpers. Update all API routes to use consistent response shapes.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/api-helpers.ts exports apiSuccess(data, status) and apiError(message, status, issues?) helpers
All API routes use these helpers for responses
Error responses always have { error: string }

tasks.title: Implement authentication gate (login page + middleware)
tasks.description: Add a /login page with PIN/password input, cookie-based session, Next.js middleware to redirect unauthenticated users, and 401 on API routes.
acceptanceCriteria: /login page with password input and submit button
Unauthenticated users redirected to /login from any dashboard route
API routes return 401 for unauthenticated requests (except /api/webhooks/*)
Session persists across page refreshes via secure httpOnly cookie
Logout button in header clears session
tasks.notes: Use a simple cookie-based approach with SETTINGS_ADMIN_PIN or a new AUTH_PASSWORD env var.

tasks.title: Add loading skeletons and rich empty states
tasks.description: Add skeleton.tsx component and implement skeleton loading + designed empty states on Templates, KB, and Studio pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Templates page: skeleton cards while loading, empty state with icon
KB page: skeleton rows while loading, empty state with suggestion
Studio page: skeleton for template dropdown while loading
tasks.notes: Skeleton already listed in TASK-001 primitives; this task implements usage on pages.

tasks.title: Custom branding: favicon, display font, metadata, clean public/
tasks.description: Replace default Next.js assets with WDUSA branding. Add a distinctive heading font. Update metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Distinctive display font loaded via next/font/google for headings
Updated metadata in layout.tsx (title, description, OG tags)
Removed default Next.js SVGs (file.svg, globe.svg, vercel.svg, next.svg)
tasks.notes: Keep window.svg if it's used. Pick a bold geometric font like Space Grotesk, DM Serif Display, or similar.

tasks.title: Build dashboard home page with stats and recent activity
tasks.description: Replace the redirect to /studio with a real dashboard showing render stats, recent renders table, and upcoming scheduled posts.
acceptanceCriteria: / route renders a dashboard page (not a redirect)
3 stat cards: total renders, renders this week, scheduled posts count
Recent Renders table (last 10) with status badge, date, output link
Quick-action buttons linking to Studio, KB, Chat
New API route /api/dashboard/stats for aggregated data
Uses UI component library from TASK-001
tasks.notes: Depends on TASK-001 (UI components) and TASK-005 (indexes for efficient queries).

tasks.title: Build render history page with filtering
tasks.description: New page at /renders showing all render jobs with status filtering, expandable details, and pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: New page at /renders added to navigation
Table/list of all render jobs: date, campaign, mode, status badge, output link
Click row to expand: input snapshot, Creatomate ID, error
Filter by status dropdown (all / rendering / succeeded / failed)
tasks.notes: New API route /api/renders with query params: status, page, limit.

tasks.title: Decompose Studio page into sub-components
tasks.description: Extract Studio page into focused sub-components under components/studio/. No file should exceed 150 lines.
acceptanceCriteria: Studio page imports: CampaignSelect, RenderModeToggle, TemplateForm, RenderScriptForm, RenderStatus, ScheduleForm
tasks.notes: Extract state management into a custom hook or keep in page with prop drilling.

tasks.title: Add inline video preview player in Studio
tasks.description: When a render succeeds with an outputUrl, show an HTML5 video player inline with controls and download button.
acceptanceCriteria: HTML5 <video> player shown when job.outputUrl is available and status is succeeded
Player has controls: play, pause, scrub, mute, fullscreen
Video in 9:16 container fitting card width
tasks.notes: Part of the RenderStatus sub-component from TASK-013.

tasks.title: Add KB fact CRUD (create, edit, delete)
tasks.description: Add create/edit/delete capabilities for individual KB facts. New API routes and UI controls on the KB page.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Fact button opens form: category, key, content, campaign profiles, source URL
Each fact card has Edit and Delete buttons
Edit opens pre-filled form; save calls PATCH /api/kb/[id]
New API routes: POST /api/kb, PATCH /api/kb/[id], DELETE /api/kb/[id]

tasks.title: Shared chat state between panel and page
tasks.description: Create a ChatProvider context so ChatPanel and ChatPage share the same useChat instance and conversation.
acceptanceCriteria: Both ChatPanel and ChatPage consume same useChat instance
Messages from panel appear on page and vice versa
Opening panel on /chat page navigates to page (no duplicate UI)
tasks.notes: DefaultChatTransport should be memoized/module-scoped to avoid re-instantiation.

tasks.title: Add AI-assisted script generation in Studio
tasks.description: Add a 'Generate with AI' button that fills hook/subhead/CTA based on campaign profile and an optional topic, using OpenAI.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate with AI button above hook/subhead/CTA fields
Click opens popover with Topic input and Generate button
Backend calls OpenAI with KB context for selected campaign profile
Generated values fill into form fields
User can regenerate or manually edit
tasks.notes: Use streaming for responsiveness. The system prompt should include relevant KB facts.

tasks.title: Build scheduling calendar view
tasks.description: New page at /calendar with monthly grid showing scheduled posts, previous/next navigation, and detail popover on click.
acceptanceCriteria: New page at /calendar added to navigation
Monthly calendar grid with posts on their dates
Post cards show caption preview and status badge
Click post to see details (media URL, GHL ID, accounts)
New API route: GET /api/scheduled-posts with date range params
tasks.notes: Use date-fns for date math. Degrade to list view on mobile.

tasks.title: Add chat prompt templates dropdown
tasks.description: Add a Templates button in chat input that shows a dropdown of 5+ built-in prompt templates for common workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Templates button in chat input area opens dropdown
At least 5 templates: reel script, batch hooks, KB search, schedule post, render status
Selecting template fills input (user can edit before sending)

tasks.title: Add page transition animations
tasks.description: Add subtle fade-up entry animation on route changes for the main content area.
acceptanceCriteria: Main content area has fade-up entry animation on route change
tasks.notes: Can be done with CSS @keyframes and a wrapper component.

tasks.title: KB re-ingest with progress indication
tasks.description: Add a Re-Ingest Sources button on the KB page with loading spinner and result count toast.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-Ingest Sources button on KB page
Button shows spinner and disables while ingesting
After completion, displays count of facts added via toast
tasks.notes: Calls existing POST /api/kb/ingest.

tasks.title: Dynamic campaign profiles (DB-driven)
tasks.description: New CampaignProfile model in Prisma. CRUD page/section. All dropdowns populated from DB instead of hardcoded.
acceptanceCriteria: New Prisma model: CampaignProfile (id, slug, displayName, description, contactPhone, contactEmail, bookingUrl, active)
Migration seeds nate_landing and corporate as initial profiles
Settings or dedicated page for CRUD
tasks.notes: KbFact.campaignProfiles stays as String[] but references CampaignProfile.slug.

tasks.title: Template preview thumbnails
tasks.description: Fetch template preview thumbnails from Creatomate API and display on the Templates page.
acceptanceCriteria: Templates page shows thumbnail for each template
Thumbnail fetched from Creatomate API or stored in VideoTemplate.thumbnailUrl
tasks.notes: Add thumbnailUrl field to VideoTemplate schema.

tasks.title: Chat history persistence in database
tasks.description: New ChatSession and ChatMessage Prisma models. Save messages as they stream. History sidebar to load past sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: New models: ChatSession (id, title, createdAt, updatedAt), ChatMessage (id, sessionId, role, content, toolCalls, createdAt)
History list in chat UI with session timestamps
New Chat button starts fresh session
tasks.notes: Complex feature — consider doing a simpler version first (just persist, no UI for browsing).

tasks.title: Creatomate webhook integration
tasks.description: New webhook endpoint for Creatomate to push render status. Update RenderJob on receipt. Frontend uses refetch instead of polling.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend refetches instead of setInterval polling
tasks.notes: Check if Creatomate plan supports webhooks. If not, implement SSE-based server-side polling.

tasks.title: Configure Vitest and write unit tests for core lib modules
tasks.description: Set up Vitest. Write tests for renderscript.ts, modifications.ts, secret-crypto.ts, creatomate.ts.
tasks.notes: Replace existing scripts/assert-modifications.ts with proper Vitest tests.

tasks.title: Add GitHub Actions CI pipeline
tasks.description: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with lint, typecheck, test, and build jobs.
acceptanceCriteria: Runs on push to main and on PRs
Build runs prisma generate before next build
All jobs pass on current codebase

tasks.title: Fix quick-win bugs (nav labels, chat FAB overlap, swallowed errors)
tasks.description: Fix the bugs identified in the audit: nav label mismatch, chat FAB z-index, swallowed template load errors, DefaultChatTransport re-instantiation.
acceptanceCriteria: nav-mobile.tsx and nav-sidebar.tsx use consistent labels
Chat FAB properly positioned on mobile (no overlap with bottom nav)
Studio template load error is logged to console
DefaultChatTransport in chat-panel.tsx and chat/page.tsx is module-scoped or memoized
tasks.notes: Quick wins — can be done in a single focused session.

tasks.title: Rate limiting on sensitive API routes
tasks.description: Add rate limiting to credential management and auth endpoints using in-memory or header-based approach.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth endpoint (if exists): 5 attempts/min per IP
429 response with Retry-After header on limit exceeded
tasks.notes: Use a simple in-memory Map-based rate limiter (sufficient for single-instance Vercel deployment).
